objective: For closed native networks of the not-all-equal knot, prove the exact identity between the witness count and the even-subgraph sum at weight -1/3 (an Ising partition function); confirm the planar Kac-Ward determinant formula on planar cubic networks, so counting is polynomial on the sphere; state the genus dependence and the general hardness as cited results.
status: Proved by NATIVE-COUNTING-20261024-001B-P001 (V1 prose proof with standard-library check; determinant formula, genus dependence and hardness cited). Closed not-all-equal worlds count 2^(-n/2) 3^n times the even-subgraph sum at -1/3, an antiferromagnetic Ising model with e^(2b) = 1/2; on planar straight-line networks the count is a square-rooted Kac-Ward determinant, polynomial on the sphere, with 4^g determinants on genus g and #P-hardness on general cubic graphs (cited, condition checked).
title: Not-all-equal worlds count like an Ising model
